title: Magellan–Elcano circumnavigation
why_famous: The first completed circumnavigation of Earth.
route_summary: Sanlúcar de Barrameda via South America, the Strait of Magellan, tropical Pacific, Guam, Cebu, Bohol, Mindanao, Palawan, Brunei, Sulu/Celebes and the Moluccas, Timor and Cape of Good Hope back to Spain.
source_title: National Historical Commission of the Philippines — First Circumnavigation route; Pigafetta chronology
geometry_note: Named ports are documented. The post-Cebu sequence follows the NHCP's Bohol–Mindanao–Mapun/Cagayan–Palawan–Brunei–Jolo–Celebes island chain before Tidore; points are approximate island/port locators, not recovered sailing fixes. Broad Pacific controls remain cartographic interpolation.

additional_sources.title: Pigafetta's account of Magellan's voyage
additional_sources.note: Primary chronology supports the western Philippine detour, Brunei, later island sightings, and return toward the Moluccas; some island identifications remain uncertain.
